scripts.demo:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npx -y node@24.14.0 scripts/create-local-demo.mjs
scripts.check: npm run setup:runtimes && npm run check:platforms && npm test && npm run test:portable && node --test tests/integration/build.test.ts && npm run check:release
scripts.build:node: vite build --config deploy/node/vite.config.ts && vite build --config deploy/node/vite.config.ts --ssr
scripts.check:platforms: npm run check:types && npm run check:types --prefix packages/agent-runtime && tsc --noEmit -p deploy/vercel/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:portable: npm run build:node && npm run build && npm test --prefix packages/agent-runtime && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/node-application.test.ts tests/node-objects.test.ts tests/node-support.test.ts tests/vercel-response.test.ts tests/integration/node-server.test.ts tests/integration/portable-runtime.test.ts

DB.description: DingBell business data. A new D1 database is provisioned; migrations run before deployment.

APP_BASE_URL.description: Exact HTTPS origin of this installation, with no path, e.g. https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev. Replace the localhost development value.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a unique identity secret of at least 32 characters, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: Generate a different random secret (at least 32 characters). Enter it on `/setup` after deployment; remove it after installing the first owner.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Your Resend API key for verification and invitation email. Required to complete first-owner installation.

MAIL_FROM.description: A verified sender address in your Resend account, e.g. DingBell <support@your-domain.example>.

STORE_CREDENTIAL_KEYS.description: Independent AES-256 key ring: JSON object with `v1` mapped to `openssl rand -base64 32`. Required before saving store credentials.

STORE_CREDENTIAL_ACTIVE_KEY.description: Active encryption-key version in STORE_CREDENTIAL_KEYS. Keep `v1` for the initial installation.
